title: Models that allow us to perceive the world more accurately also allow us to remember past events more accurately via differentiation
authors: Aslı Kılıç, Amy H. Criss, Kenneth J. Malmberg, Richard M. Shiffrin
caption_short: Schematic of Experiment 1: a self-paced study list of 150 words with a meaning question (strong lists) or a spelling question (weak lists), then an old / new test of 150 words (75 studied, 75 new); 12 cycles over two sessions.
notes: Drawn by us: the paper has no task figure. Its 13 figures are a theory illustration (Fig. 1), model simulations (Figs. 2-5, 10-13) and results (Figs. 6-9). Design details are from Section 3.1.3 (p. 73 of the journal; PDF page 9), read in the author-hosted PDF at memolab.syr.edu (saved as papers/kilic2017.pdf; publisher copyright Elsevier 2016). Example words are illustrative, not from the data.
